findings.problem: A second link to the best-sellers collection still appears in the body. .claude/rules/emails.md requires exactly one main link (to the new-arrivals collection) and says not to include any other links.
findings.fix: Delete the entire best-sellers line/link, leaving only the single new-arrivals link.

findings.problem: The link text is still the literal placeholder '[Button text](...)' instead of real call-to-action copy, as required by .claude/rules/emails.md.
findings.fix: Replace 'Button text' with real CTA copy, e.g. '[Shop new arrivals](https://usa.jafferjees.com/collections/new-arrivals)'.

findings.problem: The best-sellers link also uses the literal placeholder '[Button text](...)' rather than real CTA copy (in addition to being a disallowed second link).
findings.fix: Remove the line entirely per the high-severity finding above; no CTA copy is needed once the link is deleted.

findings.problem: Subject line 'Big Sale, Don't Miss Out' still asserts a sale without verifying it against the live site, and 'Don't Miss Out' still reads as manufactured urgency, conflicting with brand/voice.md.
findings.fix: Verify any sale/discount against the live site first; if none is confirmed, rewrite the subject without sale language or urgency, e.g. referencing the new arrivals collection itself.

findings.problem: Preview text 'Huge savings... this week only' still makes the same unverified sale claim with manufactured urgency, against brand/voice.md.
findings.fix: Check the live site for any actual current promotion before mentioning savings; otherwise rewrite without discount or urgency language.

findings.problem: Footer still uses straight apostrophes ('You're') instead of the exact required footer text in .claude/rules/emails.md, which uses curly apostrophes ('You're').
findings.fix: Replace the straight apostrophes with curly apostrophes to match the required footer text exactly.
